Client.title: Client
Client.description: Represents a client in the sales system.

name.description: The full name of the client.

email.description: The email address of the client.

phone.description: The phone number of the client.

address.description: The physical address of the client.

createdAt.description: The date and time when the client was created.

Payment.title: Payment
Payment.description: Represents a payment made by a client.

paymentMethod.description: The method of payment (e.g., credit card, cash, bank transfer).

Invoice.title: Invoice
Invoice.description: Represents an invoice issued to a client.

invoiceDate.description: The date the invoice was issued.

dueDate.description: The date the invoice is due.

totalAmount.description: The total amount due on the invoice.

status.description: The status of the invoice (e.g., sent, paid, overdue).

InvoiceItem.title: InvoiceItem
InvoiceItem.description: Represents an item within an invoice.

id.description: Unique identifier for the invoice item.

unitPrice.description: Price per unit of the item.

total.description: Total price for the item (quantity * unitPrice).

firestore.reasoning:
Based on the provided entities (Client, Payment, Invoice, InvoiceItem) and the application requirements, a straightforward relational structure is recommended. This structure prioritizes simplicity for querying and management. Authorization Independence is not enforced because the user explicitly requested all security rules be removed.

*   `/clients/{clientId}`: Stores client data. Each client document is uniquely identified by its `clientId`. This supports direct access to client information.
*   `/clients/{clientId}/payments/{paymentId}`: Stores payments associated with a specific client. This subcollection allows easy retrieval of all payments for a given client.
*   `/clients/{clientId}/invoices/{invoiceId}`: Stores invoices for a specific client, enabling efficient retrieval of a client's invoice history.
*   `/invoices/{invoiceId}/items/{itemId}`: Stores individual items associated with an invoice. This structure supports detailed invoice breakdowns.
